report_name: Strategy1 MVP Demo Dataset Build Report

indicator_definitions.MA5: 5-record rolling mean of close, including current record
indicator_definitions.MA20: 20-record rolling mean of close, including current record
indicator_definitions.20_day_high: maximum high of the prior 20 trading records, excluding current record

trend_state.ABOVE_MA5_2D: current and previous close are above their respective MA5
trend_state.ABOVE_MA5: current close is above MA5 but the two-day condition is false
trend_state.BELOW_OR_EQUAL_MA5: current close is below or equal to MA5

eligibility_rule: Rows require non-NULL MA5, MA20 and prior-20-record high; therefore each included security needs at least 21 RAW records.
checkpoint_scope: Only P1 market_daily_full_history checkpoints with status=COMMITTED are included.
